d: Short, wavy jet black hair is styled with a side part and a white lace frilled headpiece. The eyes are a pale, muted pink with a vacant, solemn expression on a face with the apparent maturity of a late teenager. A slender build is dressed in a deep purple long-sleeved dress with a white lace collar, a blue ribbon bow at the neck, and a long, ruffled white apron layered over the skirt. A small blue flower ornament is tucked into the apron, and a gold-colored metallic lantern hangs from the waist.
